title: Python range(): Represent Numerical Ranges
description: Master the Python range() function, see how it works under the hood, and learn when enumerate() or zip() beat ranges in your loops.
summary: In Python, the range() function generates a sequence of numbers, often used in loops for iteration . By default, it creates numbers starting from 0 up to but not including a specified stop value.
